**1** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/view.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/view.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **56** of **208** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **148** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9ff8154cf694c616de5d467b35af21e037de1509` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `dbe66a251a851f07014285798a8d7f6992911795` — the merge of head `0b20e1f14256008e02bbb74712e5adaba7b94632` into base `9ff8154cf694c616de5d467b35af21e037de1509`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

git fetch origin dbe66a251a851f07014285798a8d7f6992911795 && git checkout dbe66a251a851f07014285798a8d7f6992911795

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0b20e1f14256008e02bbb74712e5adaba7b94632`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-bulk-action-param-unknown-keys-refused.ts, packages/spec/liveness/view.json + ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/resolveBulkActions.ts (`toBulkParam`, main `4d3a077f`), ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/bulkParamToField.ts, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionDialog.tsx, ui/packages/types/src/objectql.ts (`BulkActionParam`), ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx, ui/packages/fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/paramToField.ts, packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.ts, packages/cli/test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts, packages/spec/scripts/build-upgrade-guide.ts, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs. Remainder at TIER_DEFAULT, the lane seat's ACCEPT: `.changeset/27050-bulk-lookup-param-prose.md`, the comment edit in `packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.test.ts`.

Inputs read: card #27050 (body, triage 6460237597, claim 6468678025, os-dev-report 6469779552), PR #27049 as merged (`c4ad55ca`, its hunk to `resolveBulkActions.ts`), PR #27255 body and file list, the net diff of `0b20e1f1` against its merge-base with `main` (`d745bb5e`; 5 files, +39/−24), and the check-runs on `0b20e1f1`. Nothing was checked out, built, run or re-run; every code reading below is `git show` / `git grep` against `origin/main` at `4d3a077f` or against the head.

### ① Derived judgments

Every sentence the diff rewrites, judged against the cited reader on `main`:

1. **"`toBulkParam` carries the field's `lookupFilters` / `lookupColumns` / `lookupPageSize` / `descriptionField`" — RIGHT.** `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/resolveBulkActions.ts` L178–181 on `main` spreads `descriptionField`, `lookupColumns`, `lookupFilters`, `lookupPageSize` onto the returned `BulkActionParam` under their own names (added by PR #27049, merge `c4ad55ca`, an ancestor of the merge-base `d745bb5e`). The premise the card and the claim state holds on `main`.
2. **"…which reach the selection bar's picker as they reach the single-record dialog's" — RIGHT, the whole chain read.** `BulkActionParam` (`ui/packages/types/src/objectql.ts` L544) carries an index-signature catch-all, so the four survive the type; `bulkParamToField` (`bulkParamToField.ts` L148–175) destructures only `name, label, type, required, help, default, multiple, options, object, labelField, placeholder` and spreads `...extra` — the four included — onto the widget field; `BulkActionDialog.tsx` L749–752 renders that field through `getLazyFieldWidget`; `LookupField.tsx` L377 reads `fieldMeta.descriptionField` and L405–407 read `fieldMeta.lookupColumns` / `lookupPageSize` / `lookupFilters`. The single-record side (`app-shell/src/utils/paramToField.ts` L161–170) hands the same four keys to the same widget. The bulk picker is the `BulkActionDialog` opened from `ObjectGrid`'s `BulkActionBar` (`ObjectGrid.tsx` L1978 → `resolvePromotedBulkParams`, L3888, L3931), so "selection bar's picker" names the right surface.
3. **"`idField` / `titleFormat` are still not carried" — RIGHT.** `toBulkParam` has no `idField` or `titleFormat` line; the resolver (`resolveActionParams.ts` L815, L817) fills them from the snake-only `field.id_field` / `field.title_format` and its L399–402 comment says the camel twins are deliberately absent. `LookupField` would read a carried `idField` (L367, L378), so the sentence is a fact about the adapter, not about the widget — the right thing for the prose to say.
4. **"`idField` has no `FieldSchema` spelling to declare" — RIGHT.** The only `idField` in `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` is L1007 inside `InlineGridColumnSchema` (L970); `FieldSchema` starts at L1104 and declares `descriptionField` / `lookupColumns` / `lookupPageSize` / `lookupFilters` at L1823–1835 and no `idField`.
5. **Counts.** "all but six of these keys" / "those six keys" / "for one of those six": `accept`, `maxSize` + the four = six members of `BULK_PARAM_WIDGET_CONFIG_KEYS` (20 members on the head, list unchanged). Right.
6. **Accept set — byte-unchanged.** The diff to `bulk-action.zod.ts` touches only the JSDoc block (L147–169) and the `prescription` string of the `BULK_PARAM_WIDGET_CONFIG_KEYS` guidance set (L257–267). `BULK_PARAM_WIDGET_CONFIG_KEYS` itself, the `strictObject` key list, the per-key renames and the `history` string are not in the diff. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right; no authorable key, value or default moves, so no `check:authorable-surface` / `check:api-surface` artifact is owed and none is in the diff.
7. **The migration entry's text change is safe.** `18.ui-bulk-action-param-unknown-keys-refused.ts` changes only its `replacement` and `reason` strings; `id`, `surface`, `acceptanceCriteria` and the file's position are unchanged. Readers of that text on `main`: `os migrate meta` prints `surface → replacement`, `why: reason`, `verify: acceptanceCriteria` at runtime (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.ts` L790, L800–802); `build-upgrade-guide.ts` L135–137 projects it into `packages/spec/protocol-upgrade-guide.md` and `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/`, both gitignored (`.gitignore` L114, L150), and `check:upgrade-guide` / `check:spec-changes` run `--check` in memory against no committed copy (`packages/spec/spec-changes.json` gitignored, L149). Nothing pins the prose: `packages/cli/test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts` pins the id roster (L300) and builds its expected print from the entry's own fields (L344–345); `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` reads no `reason` / `replacement`. `git grep ui-bulk-action-param-unknown-keys-refused` on `main` hits only the entry, that test and `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`. So the change is runtime-visible upgrade guidance and nothing else — which is why the `patch` changeset is owed (judged in ②).
8. **Copy sweep — complete.** On `main` the old claim lives in exactly the six places the diff rewrites (`bulk-action.zod.ts` L160–165 and L262, the entry L37 and L67–69, `view.json` L198, the test comment L80). On the head, `git grep` of the "dropped" forms across `packages/**`, `ui/**`, `skills/**`, `content/docs/**` (CHANGELOGs excluded) returns nothing; the four remaining hits of "only `accept` / `maxSize`" are all the corrected six-key sentences. `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` carry no copy on either tree, so the dev's "not governed" reading is right and the `Governed Surface Queue Guard` agrees. The three `ui/packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` and `packages/{spec,rest}/CHANGELOG.md` lines quoting the old text are release-owned history and correctly left alone.
9. **`view.json` row — right and mergeable.** The `list.bulkActionDefs` note's new clause is true per item 2; `main` moved `view.json` since the merge-base (form-view rows for #27155, +24/−10) without touching this row, and `git merge-tree origin/main 0b20e1f1` produces a tree with no conflict. The row keeps its pre-existing sha-less objectui citations; this PR adds none.

Non-blocking observation (pre-existing wording, not introduced here): both the prescription and the entry end "…and the rest are never read off the field", while the resolver does read `id_field` / `title_format` off the field and then the bulk adapter drops them. The JSDoc states that precisely; the two runtime strings inherit the older shorthand. Not a FAIL item — the sentence is unchanged in meaning from `main` and the accurate statement ships in the same file — but a one-clause tightening next time this string moves would be welcome.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/27050-bulk-lookup-param-prose.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, carrying `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, matching the PR body. Right: the diff publishes a changed refusal string and a changed migration-entry text inside `@objectstack/spec`'s `dist` — behaviour-neutral prose a consumer can observe (the parse error text, `os migrate meta` output) — so "none" takes `patch`, never `skip-changeset`. No export, key, value or default moves, so no `minor`; no BREAKING banner or ADR-0087 marker is owed. `Check Changeset` on the head: success.

Clause-②: no

Dev flags (os-dev-report 6469779552 and the PR body), each answered:

- **`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` NOT MEASURED locally.** Both are hosted by `ci.yml` job `build-core`, display name `Build Core` (`.github/workflows/ci.yml` L2805–2806; steps at L3069 and L3093), a required context. Conclusion on `0b20e1f1`: see the gate table below.

- **"`skills/**` / `content/docs/**` / `ui/**` hold no copy."** Confirmed on `main` and on the head (item 8).

## 维护者速读 (席位终稿)

- 改了什么：只改说明文字。批量操作参数说明、拒收处方、v18 迁移条目和 `view.json` 存活行原来都说批量路径会丢掉查找字段的四个设置。现在改为：`lookupFilters`、`lookupColumns`、`lookupPageSize`、`descriptionField` 会带到选择栏的选择器，和单条记录的对话框一样；`idField` / `titleFormat` 仍然不带。
- 为什么改：PR #27049 已经让批量路径带上这四个设置，原文字变成了错误的指导。
- 风险与回滚：接受集逐字不变，只动文案（`@objectstack/spec` patch）。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts` 中 `BULK_PARAM_WIDGET_CONFIG_KEYS` 上方的说明和拒收处方。
- 两分钟验证：在仓库里 grep「dropped by the bulk adapter」，应为 0 处。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

席位意见：接受。契约复核 PASS（6470336310）：每句新文字在 main 上都有对应的读取方，旧说法在全仓库已清零，迁移条目的文字改动不影响任何门禁。

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · `domain:spec` seat 3 · `os-support-ai` · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP` · 2026-10-28T13:32Z

Head: `0b20e1f14256008e02bbb74712e5adaba7b94632` · card #27050 · claim 6468678025

1. **形态:** a draft PR to `main` carrying `Fixes #27050`: 5 paths (+39 / −24), inside the claim's surface. It edits the JSDoc and the refusal prescription in `bulk-action.zod.ts`, the `replacement` / `reason` of the semantic entry `18.ui-bulk-action-param-unknown-keys-refused`, the `list.bulkActionDefs` liveness row and one test comment, and adds an `@objectstack/spec` patch changeset. `check-governed-merges --pr 27255` reports NOT governed, so the ordinary queue landing applies. The assignee is `os-support-ai`.
2. **前提实测:** the premise holds. PR #27049 (merged) makes `toBulkParam` forward the four picker settings, and the review traced each one to its reader: `BulkActionParam`'s catch-all, `bulkParamToField`, `BulkActionDialog`, `LookupField.tsx`. It also confirmed that `idField` / `titleFormat` are not carried. `BULK_PARAM_WIDGET_CONFIG_KEYS` (20 keys) and the strict key list are outside the diff, so the accept set is byte-unchanged and `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` hold. The old "dropped" claim lived in exactly the six places the diff rewrites, and the head has 0 hits across `packages/**`, `ui/**`, `skills/**` and `content/docs/**`.
3. **门禁 check-runs (on this head):** 49 runs read at 2026-10-28T13:32Z: 39 success, 10 skipped, none red or pending. Every required context is success, except `Lint UI`, which its own paths filter skips, as `check-required-contexts.mjs` records. 4. **接受的偏差:**
   - (a) The dev also fixed the v18 migration entry's `replacement` / `reason` and one test comment, beyond the three named sentences. `os migrate meta` prints those strings, the CLI test builds its expectation from the entry's own fields, and no gate reads them.
   - (b) Kept as noted, not owed here: the refusal prescription and the migration entry still end "the rest are never read off the field". The resolver does read `id_field` / `title_format` before the bulk adapter drops them, so the end result for an author is the same. The JSDoc states it precisely. This is the older shorthand, and it gets tightened the next time those strings move.
5. **范围外去向:** none owed.
6. **落地条款:** the seat checked the prose faces against the diff on this head: the PR body, the changeset and the rewritten strings. The seat readies the PR and arms auto-merge in this act, follows it to MERGED, and lands #27050.
